canonical_project: DST colocation service (resale of UNN capacity)
notes: DST official page offers colocation hosting (A). December 2025 agreement (The Bruneian/The Scoop, 2025-12-03, B) lets DST resell UNN data centre co-location capacity at Tungku Zone 8 and Sumbiling Telephone House. DST is asset-light since the 2020 consolidation; physical facilities are UNN's (own-facility details U).
